scope_boundary: PPO + critic are genuinely active on the residual path (not the trunk's; Contract v4 §7). PPO stabilizes the trainer (no clamp/collapse) -- but the residual == anchor (edit_rate 0): a MISSING-DIRECTION-SIGNAL outcome (no beneficial-edit gradient; R4-R5), NOT a PPO/trainer failure.
